rock_and_stone.modifications: Color desaturated and brightened into neutral rock and dusty masonry variants. JPEG recompression. These textures are a material analogue, not a scan of Kharpocho.

sand_plaster_timber.source: Original deterministic procedural material generation for this project

geometry_displacement: The terrain relief is modeled directly into the mesh; the viewer also applies subtle rock/masonry height-map displacement. GLB exports preserve modeled relief, but standard glTF omits shader displacement.
